name: 92590 · Temecula, CA
findings: ZIP 92590 (Temecula) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92590 (Temecula) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92590 (Temecula) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
